data.notes: March 2027 is still early-announced, but confirmed highlights already span LA indie rooms, electronic one-offs, a Lusophone pop stop, and the major Southern California rave calendar.

events.title: Beyond Wonderland Southern California 2027
events.summary: Insomniac’s Beyond Wonderland SoCal returns to NOS Events Center in San Bernardino on March 26–27, 2027. The official site confirms the dates and venue for the two-day electronic festival.

events.title: Insomniac Presents Alan Walker – LEGEND OF ATLANTIS Tour
events.summary: Insomniac presents Alan Walker’s LEGEND OF ATLANTIS Tour at The Torch at LA Coliseum. AXS confirms the Saturday, March 6, 2027 Los Angeles date at 6:00 PM.

events.title: Midnight Lovers with Axel Boman all night
events.summary: Resident Advisor reports that Axel Boman’s year-long Los Angeles residency with Midnight Lovers concludes on March 20, 2027 with an all-night set. The residency is framed around house, techno, and disco.

events.title: Calema – Origin Tour
events.summary: Calema brings the Origin Tour to The Bellwether on March 19, 2027. The venue describes the duo’s sound as blending African rhythms, pop, and Latin music.

events.title: Vacations – Pursuit Of Anything Tour
events.summary: Australian indie-pop band Vacations headlines the Hollywood Palladium with twen. Ticketmaster confirms the March 19, 2027 date, 7:00 PM doors, and 8:00 PM show.

events.title: Open Melody 2027
events.summary: Open Melody 2027 is confirmed for March 26–28, 2027 at 2220 Arts + Archives in Los Angeles. The independent festival focuses on adventurous, border-crossing music; lineup details were not yet posted on the source page.

events.title: Blondshell – Scaring Strangers Tour
events.summary: Blondshell brings the Scaring Strangers Tour to The Wiltern on March 2, 2027. The Live Nation event page confirms the Los Angeles date and venue.

events.title: Michelle Branch – Everywhere And Back Again Tour
events.summary: Michelle Branch brings the Everywhere And Back Again Tour to The Wiltern. The Live Nation event page confirms the March 13, 2027 Los Angeles performance.

events.title: Oscars Awards After Party at The Roosevelt Hotel
events.summary: This Oscars-night party at The Hollywood Roosevelt lists Devin Lucien and DJ Tay James for a 9:00 PM–2:00 AM event. Resident Advisor confirms the March 14, 2027 date and house/hip-hop music billing.

events.title: Ely Oaks at Academy LA
events.summary: A 21+ late-night Academy LA date from Berlin-based dance producer Ely Oaks, billed for 10 PM with EDM, techno, trance, and commercial dance crossover energy.

events.title: VNV Nation
events.summary: A Los Angeles stop for VNV Nation’s rescheduled North American tour, bringing the group’s synthpop, trance, and EBM-rooted electronic following to The Belasco.

events.title: Sungazer with Button Masher
events.summary: Sungazer plays Teragram Ballroom with support from Button Masher. The bill is confirmed as a jazz-fusion/electronic-leaning concert with doors listed for March 2, 2027.

events.title: Wasia Project – Nocturne Live 2027
events.summary: Wasia Project’s Nocturne Live 2027 tour stops at The Wiltern on March 3, 2027. Ticketmaster confirms the Los Angeles venue, date, and 7:00 PM doors.

events.title: Kid Francescoli – A Kind Wave Tour
events.summary: Kid Francescoli’s A Kind Wave Tour stops at Teragram Ballroom. Ticketmaster confirms the Los Angeles date as March 24, 2027, with doors at 7:00 PM and show at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Valley with Moody Joody – Do You Need To Be Entertained? Tour
events.summary: Canadian alternative-pop band Valley plays The Bellwether with Moody Joody. The venue page confirms the March 2, 2027 date with doors at 7:00 PM and show at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Oscar Ortiz
events.summary: Goldenvoice presents Oscar Ortiz at The Roxy on March 27, 2027. AXS confirms the 9:00 PM all-ages Los Angeles concert.

events.title: Circus Runaways Anniversary: Originality — The Fifth Element of Breaking
events.summary: A two-day breaking and hip-hop culture gathering with youth 1v1, pro 3-on-3 TBA, DJs, vendors, and a warehouse-style big-top layout centered on originality in b-boy/b-girl movement.

events.title: WEST COAST RIOT
events.summary: A B.W.S.A-presented hard-dance/gabber night at Exchange LA running 11 PM–6 AM, headlined by Marius Tiberian with Ravencore and Kryon support.
